# WebSyndic

> > WebSyndic is a community-driven content aggregation and curation platform combining local directories, news feeds, user-generated lists, polls, and videos with social reaction features.

WebSyndic operates as a multi-format content platform enabling users to discover, share, and engage with curated news, lists, polls, and videos across technology, business, health, and lifestyle topics. The platform emphasizes community participation through user reactions, social sharing, and interactive content discovery.

## Key Topics

- content-aggregation
- news-feed

## Core Content Discovery

- [Home](https://websyndic.eu): WebSyndic homepage for local directories, news aggregation, and content curation
- [Blog](https://websyndic.eu/blog): Blog aggregator for sharing breaking news and user-submitted content
- [Lists](https://websyndic.eu/lists): Create and share viral lists on technology, news, and business topics

## Interactive Features

- [Polls](https://websyndic.eu/polls): Community polling feature for health, wellness, and lifestyle topics
- [Videos](https://websyndic.eu/videos): Video library and aggregation for popular, funny, and product review content

## User Reactions & Engagement

- [AWESOME!](https://websyndic.eu/reactions/awesome): User reaction page for awesome content feedback and social sharing
- [LOVED](https://websyndic.eu/reactions/loved): User reaction page for loved content and social sharing engagement
- [NICE](https://websyndic.eu/reactions/nice): User reaction page for nice content feedback and engagement
- [FUNNY](https://websyndic.eu/reactions/funny): User reaction page for funny content voting and engagement
- [OMG!](https://websyndic.eu/reactions/omg): User reaction page for surprising content with OMG emotion response
- [FAIL!](https://websyndic.eu/reactions/fail): User reaction page for fail content feedback and social curation
- [LOL](https://websyndic.eu/reactions/loL): User reaction page for funny content with LOL emoji feedback
- [EW!](https://websyndic.eu/reactions/ew): User reaction page for negative content feedback and engagement

## Optional

- [Language Selection](https://websyndic.eu/selectlanguge/en): Language selection page for English version of WebSyndic platform
